meta.what: flat horizon, apparent Sun centre (standard refraction), no snow, no terrain; hours per 365-day year
meta.year_phases_meaning: every Sun table (all hours, long spells, median stretch) is the mean over year_phases calendars, each an eighth of a day on from the one before, centred on the middle of the leap cycle: where noon falls against the seasons differs from year to year inside the leap cycle and with longitude, and a single calendar moved a cell's long-spell hours by up to 9 h a year; longest_spell_h is the mean of the calendars' longest spells; the version 2 thresholds (bin median) keep a single calendar
meta.long_window: the time inside unbroken spells of at least the minimum length with the Sun in the band, followed day by day (a spell through midnight is one spell)
meta.lowest_lat_with_long_window: the lowest latitude at which the longest spell of the year (mean over the calendars; they differ by seconds there) reaches the minimum
meta.lowest_lat_with_long_window_bin_median: the version 2 rule, kept for comparison: the lowest latitude with a ten-day bin whose median longest stretch (two-minute steps) reaches the minimum
meta.longest_spell_h: the longest single spell of the year (not capped at a day)
meta.longest_stretch_h: the best ten-day median of the longest stretch per day (version 2; for information)
meta.half_years: oct_mar is 28 September to 31 March (northern winter, southern summer); apr_sep is the rest
